filename.description: Source file, relative to the documents root WITHOUT a 'documents/' prefix (e.g. 'deployment.md'). Use list_files first if you are unsure of the path.

output_filename.description: Optional output path, only if the user asked for a specific name. Default: same folder, '<name>-<LANG>.<ext>' (e.g. 'deployment-DE.md').

source_lang.description: Source language code (optional, auto-detected if omitted)

formality.description: Form of address for languages that distinguish it (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, PT, JA, RU): 'prefer_less' = informal (German 'du'), the default — documentation, chat, private messages; 'prefer_more' = formal (German 'Sie') — business, official, legal and customer-facing texts; 'default' leaves it to DeepL. Choose by the text's audience; a form of address the user asks for wins.
